notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.0.9 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is LIFUEL.
[p align="start"]We would like to share an announcement regarding the content we uploaded early this morning. Since convenience improvements and bug fixes are always better when applied quickly, updates may sometimes go live before the official notice is posted. We kindly ask for your understanding.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]This patch focuses on improving various shortcomings in the game overall.
[p align="start"]Details are as follows:
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
Balance Adjustments
Cooldown calculation formula changed



Cooldowns will now be calculated using compound reduction instead of simple reduction. Previously, cooldowns could easily reach 0 seconds even without core modifications, which undermined the value of other builds and, in the long run, negatively impacted gameplay. We’ve addressed this while keeping cooldown-focused builds strong. Fixed values will now be applied after compounding, ensuring their value remains impactful.



Increased the duration of starting boosters available from Isaac from 3 → 6 encounters.

Weapon Mod: DDoS Blade duration reduced from 4 → 2 seconds.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
UX and Text
Corrected commentary for Piercing Drill.

Adjusted “Charge” keyword.

Adjusted “Burn” keyword (pending request).

Fixed an intermittent crash when the player dies during the Jewel Collector’s attack in Stage 3.

“Amplify” keyword split



To clearly distinguish between “Amplify” and “Increase,” we have separated them into different keywords. A tutorial explaining this will be added in a future codex update. Please note this may cause some odd translations at first—if you spot issues, please report them and we’ll fix them right away.



Corrected English text for “Blurred Path.”
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
Convenience Improvements
Fixed an issue where, after unlocking a weapon and quitting the game, the save would revert to the pre-unlocked weapon, causing incorrect attacks to appear.

Fixed an issue where previewing immediately changed the EquippedWeapon in PlayingData (this also resolves mismatches between the displayed weapon and basic attacks after loading a save).

Improved responsiveness of downward attacks.

Fixed an exploit where dismantling while rearranging Combo Skills allowed infinite Blue P extraction.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous
Loop count tracking changed (now counts loop progression instead of death count).

Fixed skill modifications not being reflected in records.

Fixed suspicious NPC dialogue after defeating Dr. Wolf showing in Korean only.

Fixed certain languages displaying three times simultaneously in the Stage 1 Scrap Robot event.

Relaxed activation condition for “Pressure Headgear” module and fixed cases where it would not trigger.

Fixed issue where the Whistle’s “Energy +1” effect was not applied.

Adjusted color of system unlock counters.

Fixed certain cases where AED, Whistle, and Precision Tuning Driver did not function correctly:



When swapping order or dismantling skills, additional effects could trigger incorrectly.



Adjusted text position for the Mole guarding the entrance.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
Closing[p align="start"]We reviewed feedback from the forums, Discord, and other channels and compiled everything internally. We are very grateful for all the thoughtful suggestions—they’ve been a huge help to development. We pay particular attention to clarity of text and translations. Though there is still much room for improvement, your reports are invaluable. Thank you once again to everyone across different countries helping us with language-related support.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.0.8 Update (Codex Update!)
notes.notes:
Hi protectors! This is LIFUEL.

This update brings a new feature, the Compendium.

Originally, we planned to launch "Hard Mode (Alert Level)" at the end of September. However, through your feedback, we realized that many players would like to have access to game information, so we've developed the Compendium feature in addition to our original schedule. (The original schedule is still on track, so don't worry.)

We have made many internal adjustments in the process of preparing the Compendium, so we would like to explain the changes and additions through this announcement.




Database
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/e53e3fb3f97c81592853fc5640f6d122acc1ef60.png"]

The database contains two main types of information:

- Intelligence Database: All information within the game can be viewed.

- Logs: You can review the records of previous runs.






Library
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/c5f80cc740cf9e8e14e481c236f306cb746702a5.png"]

There are 5 types of information that can be viewed in the Library:

- Skills and components

- Modules

- Weapon modifications

- Enemies

- Systems

It contains some elements that have not been explicitly explained before, such as:

- Differences in skill borders (rarity levels)

- Skill attributes and attribute-exclusive special parts



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/35fc250cc1ace2801c0ec7e203255cb9806213c3.png"]



Of course system-related explanations have also been added. Players will be able to revisit what they have learned in the tutorials, while also including explanations that only exist at the system level. The UI of the original tutorials will also be unified into the library design stiyle.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/aa2beb0dc8a06ca1400ab6953a8deddf6ebe4348.png"]

To help players better understand, we have added some new images and descriptions for content that currently exists only as a system. Hopefully these will become part of the game guide. These contents are based on the questions that you often ask, we will also keep optimizing and adjusting based on players feedback if there's any new feedback in the future.

The following content has been added in this update:

- Destructive power and damage value

- Accumulation

- Increase and increase degrees

- Direct and indirect attacks (mutual objects)

- And the others.






Log


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/8bca7788ad304b268b2619f99c7ca0a733763714.png"]

In the log, players can view skills, modules, etc. gained from previous playthroughs. The UI/UX is consistent with the backpack, allowing for intuitive viewing of detailed information.


Loop Record
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/7b1749771ab658c636e8437440f03cd353533d86.png"]

When a run is over, a summary message is displayed, giving players an at-a-glance look at the results of the run.


Conclusion
During this development process, we thought about how to give players more detailed information about the game. Also, we standardized some of the design and explanation methods and put a lot of thought into the ease of operation.

However, these convenience improvements are not new game features, and we are preparing the next update with more care. Here I would like to briefly describe the update plan.

The next update will introduce Hard Mode (Alert Level) as indicated in the roadmap. Previously, Alert Levels 1~3 only adjusted the difficulty through numerical changes. Originally, during the Early Access phase, we only intended to build the system first, and then gradually add the levels afterward, but considering that the game has slightly less content, we temporarily added the minimum levels into the game and launched the game, which is the current version.

Next we will remake it to recreate a more complete system:

- 1~3 stage remake

- Adding Alert Levels

There are two directions we're going in regarding the Alert Levels:

The first is to add systems and content that will allow players to gradually experience the full level of the game as envisioned by the development team.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/10d04f2d8f2807bb2b6df0113fb166fd92413a61.png"]

New enemies and systems will be added and integrated with existing systems to provide players with a deeper gameplay experience. The ultimate goal is makle our players and developers to reach a near-identical understanding of the game.

Secondly, challenge by design: taking higher risks in choices, but the corresponding higher rewards. Higher alert levels don't just add unreasonable restrictions, they make the game more action-packed and strategic.

The above updates are scheduled to go live at the end of September. September will be a busy month for development, but we'll still keep in touch with you all and actively take your comments into account in an effort to bring a great update.

Thank you all!

notes.title: [Development Update] Reroll & Compendium
notes.notes:
Hi protectors! This is LIFUEL.



Recently, we’ve received a lot of feedback from players, and two of the hottest topics have been the Reroll/Dice Mechanic and the Compendium System. Today, we’d like to take this opportunity to share a bit about our plans for these features.


Dice
One of the core joys of our game is giving players the freedom to shape their ideal builds, and dice plays a very important role in this. If the number of dice is too limited, the game risks becoming a roguelike experience that relies purely on randomness, which in turn reduces strategic depth.



We share the same view as many of you: when exploring builds, there should be both the fun of adapting to random environments and the ability to manipulate probabilities through rerolls, allowing players to gradually realize their ideal builds. That’s why we’re planning improvements to the dice system, and we’ll incorporate as much of your feedback as possible in the upcoming version.

PS: We are still actively gathering new feedback and ideas, so please understand that the contents mentioned here may be subject to change during development.



Confirmed Development Directions:

Increasing the number of dice obtainable in Omega

Adding additional ways to acquire dice

Granting +1 dice upon defeating mini-bosses (for example)

…and more!



This update is currently targeted for September, though development may take a little time. Some of you may have already noticed that compared to completed player builds, wolves are still underpowered. Therefore, along with expanding the number of dice, we also aim to introduce a Hard Mode in the same update.



Of course, if you have even better ideas or suggestions, we’ll be more than happy to adopt them and keep optimizing. Please continue sending us your feedback—we’ll read every single comment with care!


Compendium
We’ve noticed that many players would like a comprehensive compendium that gathers all information on skills, modules, weapon modifications, systems, and more. After all, with the limited number of dice rolls in the game, it’s difficult to fully grasp every element.



Therefore, we are currently developing a compendium system to help players better plan their builds.

The features we expect to include are roughly as follows:
[olist]
Descriptions related to skills, modules, weapon modifications, enemies, and systems.

Detailed mechanics of skills and effects

 - In-depth explanations on things like destructive power, electric shocks, etc.

 - Trigger conditions for exclusive passives

 - And more!

Reserved space for future content expansion (with the potential for further updates)
[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/a7d50c651c63438a0a2410518a4228fbcd81821a.png"]



Currently, we have completed the UX design in Figma and have officially started the UI design. While the UX prototype currently shown is still quite basic (mainly composed of simple blocks), rest assured that we will soon incorporate artistic design to present a more intuitive and visually appealing compendium interface.


Closing Remarks
Beyond this, we are also aware that everyone has many other pieces of feedback, and we will work to implement improvements as quickly as possible. We are truly happy and grateful to be developing this game together with all of you.



Once again, we sincerely thank everyone for your support and suggestions—each piece of advice helps drive the growth of Ovis Loop!

After reading everyone's feedback carefully, we decided to add these passive skills to the game and make some minor optimizations on top of the original ones. notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
About Windows Defender Antivirus
Hi protectors! This is LIFUEL.



We’d like to address a recent issue where our game was mistakenly flagged by antivirus software, preventing some players from running it properly. We have already released a fix and would like to explain the cause in detail.



Our game is built on a custom in-house engine, with its overall structure consisting of three main files:



· OVIS LOOP.exe: the launcher file, which only starts the game.

· DWEngine2D.dll: the engine file, serving as the foundation for the game to run.

· ClientDLL.dll: the file related to game logic.



During development, for testing purposes, we designed a mechanism that would create a duplicate of ClientDLL.dll when running the game, allowing us to integrate new game builds while the game was running. However, due to our oversight, this mechanism was unintentionally left in the release version, which triggered Windows Defender’s interception and false positive. We immediately removed the mechanism and uploaded a patched version once we discovered the issue



We want to make it absolutely clear that there was no malicious code of any kind in the game. This issue was purely the result of inexperience and a mistake on our side. This is our very first full development and release cycle, and there are certainly areas where we still have a lot to learn. 

We sincerely apologize for the trouble and inconvenience this has caused.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/5fe646c7348463efa15e97256fa2e6ba84ed04e8.png"]


Updates
Thank you very much for giving us love and support even though there are still quite a few bugs in the game. It is because of everyone's feedback that we can continue to improve and refine the game. In this update, we have prioritized fixing some serious bugs and issues that may affect the game experience.



At the same time, we have also optimized some of the content that needs to be adjusted based on player feedback and live videos, fixed the bug where the Critical Hit Booster in the "X Crusher" combo skill took effect abnormally, and adjusted the recovery durations of various weapons.



“Charging Hammer” was overpowered in the previous playtest, so we nerfed it at launch. However, we found that this made it a "low return for high risk" weapon, so we've increased its base effect, the energy proportional damage bonus, from 4% to 7%.



The electrical build has the advantage of being able to easily overwhelm enemies in a complete setup, but its pure damage performance was a bit lacking. Therefore, we have adjusted it so that the electrical build damage can be adapted to the player's destructive power (Attack Power/Strength Attribute).


Bug Fixes
Fixed issues related to random probability

Fixed the issue where limited one-time rewards would be replaced when receiving rewards on the title screen or after exiting the game.

Fixed the issue that when weapon modification is performed, only low-level modification options appear.

Fixed the issue that using the "X Crusher" combo skill causes a +30% bonus to the strike rate.

This effect should only be applied to basic attacks, but was too powerful when applied to combos, so this has been fixed.

Fixed the game crash issue when breaking down skills after interacting with the weapon transformation UI.

Fixed the occasional crash issue caused by restoring props.

Weapon Bug Fixes and Balance Adjustments

Fixed the weapon modification issue that Electro Rapier with Last Basic Attack effect cannot be triggered correctly during the last basic attack.

Fixed the issue where the default effect (25% chance to refresh cooldown when using a skill) of the Electro Rapier would prioritize resetting combo skills over basic skills when triggered.

Changed the weapon description of Electro Rapier from "Incomplete Electric Shock" to "Electric Shock+1".

Fixed the occasionally crash issue when the character died after fighting the miniboss Three Fools in Stage 2.

Fixed the issue where "Burn Damage +30%" in Burn did not take effect.

Fixed the issue where Contaminated Cutter does not lose HP due to the damage reduction effect when grabbing skills.

Fixed the issue where Contaminated Cutter's grab judgement remained after charging into a wall.

Fixed an issue where Contaminated Cutter's grab skill could cause the character to get stuck in a wall.

Fixed an issue where some skill cooldown reduction effects were being calculated twice.

Fixed the issue where the maximum life reduction effect of the Raw Mantium only takes effect once in the Omega Project.

Fixed the issue where the attack speed was abnormally increased after removing the Manium Amplifier.

Fixed the issue where Refined Manium resulted in an abnormal display of Stamina.

Fixed an issue where the Overseer's Stopwatch did not function properly when both the Overseer's Stopwatch and theHigh-capacity Battery were used at the same time.

The Enhanced Mag of the Burst Blade has been changed to work properly, instead of not applying to the Basic Attack effect.


Balance Adjustments
Increased the stats required to stunning Dr. Wolf.

Added a new warning indicator when Dr. Wolf performs a powerful attack, to help players react accordingly.

Stunning stats will reset whenever Dr. Wolf unleashes a powerful attack.

Base recovery duration for Great Sword, Electro Rapier, and Flame Sword reduced from 2s to 1.5s.

Charging Hammer base effect increased: damage bonus per Energy point raised from 4% to 7%.

Electric effect has been simplified. Lightning strikes generated by electric now scale with the player’s Might (Attack/Strength attribute).

 Old: Every 5 stacks of electric effect triggered a lightning strike after 3s, dealing 6–16 damage (not affected by Might).

 New: Every 5 stacks of Shock now trigger a lightning strike after 3s, dealing 10 damage (scales with Might).

Effect of Runner’s High improved: Attack Speed bonus per Energy point raised from 1% to 2%.

Revival Module cost reduced from 40 to 30 Manium Crystals.

Omega Project revival effect buffed: now restores full HP upon revival.

Blue-P rewards from map nodes adjusted to 125 ~ 150.

All enemies will now drop at least 1 Blue-P upon defeat (excluding token mobs such as bats in Stage 3 or summoned minions that normally don’t drop currency).

Enemy placement and generation in Stage 2 have been completely adjusted.

In Stage 3 “Windfall” event, HP cost increased from 6 to 20.


Others
When moving left or right on the map, players can long press the button to move faster.

Increased the font size of burn damage by 50%.

Changed the translation of "Radar" in Japanese.

Shortened some English text and fixed other mistranslations.

Fixed the issue that some plots of land did not have a stomping judgment.

notes.title: [2025.08.17]Patch Notes - 0.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278504/731faf4fd7b56c368646c74581b34e85d50fdfbb.png"]

Hi protectors! This is LIFUEL.



We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the numerous bugs in the game. At the same time, we would like to express our deep gratitude for all the support and feedback you’ve given.



In this update, we mainly focused on fixing the occasional crashes, making balance adjustments, and implementing various improvements.



Many players have raised concerns about the game’s balance, especially the sudden difficulty spike in the second stage and the balance issues with the second boss. To address this, we've made changes to the placement and types of enemies without nerfing them to offer you a better game experience on the action part. Additionally, we added backswing to some actions, making it easier for players to find opportunities to deal damage.



After investigating the seemingly unreasonable damage, we found that this was not caused by one specific enemy but rather a result of multiple factors stacking together. So we’ve minimized the changes to the stats in this balance patch. Please see below for details.



Moreover, we’ve prioritized the crash issues and other severe problems that affect gameplay experience. Although not all issues were resolved in this patch, we will continue to work on fixing the remaining bugs step by step.




Bug Fixes:
Fixed problem with HP increase due to Meta-progression not being applied

Fixed the crash issue in Stage 1 village

Confirmed that a specific language file was the cause

Fixed issue with protective clothing module not restoring max HP

Fixed issue with cloud sync repeatedly showing up even when local cloud is up to date

Fixed an issue with Dr. Wolf occasionally going off-screen

Fixed an issue where Dr. Wolf would stop acting after passing out

Partially fixed game crashing issue

This is a major improvement to a bug that causes certain users to force quit the game for no reason. A summary is as follows:

Fixed the design flaw in the animation-related code used throughout the game causing intermittent force closures

Fixed the problem with the order in which memory is released when switching between scenes, causing intermittent terminations

Fixed the problem that caused forced termination when a large number of token units (monsters summoned by the enemy) were generated

Fixed some forced termination that occurred when interacting with modules and elephant shop

(We have confirmed that it was mostly caused by interactions with modules However, we would appreciate it if you could report us if you find similar issue with skill boxes or weapon modification boxes as well)

Fixed an issue in alpha mode where the player would take 1 damage when taking 0 damage

Changes:
Reduced damage dealt by all ranged enemies

Reduced number of ranged enemies and increased number of melee enemies in all stages

Removed Admin Wolf's buff Double Attack and reduced its damage bonus from 50% to 25%

Slightly reduced Stage 1 boss rockfall damage

Added VFX for Stage 1 Bag Wolf

Reduced Stage 1 miniboss Meteorite Destroyer damage

Changed the placement of Shield Wolf and traps

Stage 2 boss Phase 2 appearance requirement changed from 60% HP to 40% HP

Added post attack delay and VFX effect to Stage 2 boss

Fixed VFX effect and added post attack delay for Stage 2 miniboss Scrap Collector

Slightly reduced overall health and damage of Stage 2 minibosses

Fixed an issue where the critical hit chance of the Stage 2 miniboss Watcher was being applied unintentionally

Added AoE UI for Stage 2 miniboss Watcher

Fixed the attack pattern stack issue at the end of Stage 2 miniboss Watcher's laser skill

Reduced the damage of Stage 3 Bite Wolf

Significantly reduced the damage of the admin version of the Stage 3 Bite wolf (this was unintentionally overpowered)
*IMPORTANT: Fixed a bug where "Damage taken -1" in the shield module was incorrectly stated as "Damage taken ×2"
(We are sincerely sorry for this issue, this is where most of the sudden deaths can be related)


Other fixes:
Fixed some translation errors (thanks for the feedback).

Fixed the issue where a single sentence in Korean would appear when player rejoined a conversation with hyenas after being declined

[p align="start"]The most frequently reported issues at the moment are the difficulty of Stage 2 Boss Phase 2, the difficulty of the “Three Idiots” elite enemy, and frequent game crashes.
[p align="start"]
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]
[p align="start"]First, regarding the Stage 2 balance adjustments:
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]The boss’s Phase 2 originally spawned poison clouds continuously, making the difficulty higher. The original design intent was to add a jump mechanic to the dodge-focused action, increasing the control difficulty slightly. However, due to overly large hitboxes and high damage, the gameplay became overly exhausting. We have adjusted the hitbox size and damage values accordingly.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]For Stage 2 Boss Phase 2’s downward slam attack that creates a damage-over-time area, we found that the duration was too long, making the fight unnecessarily unfair. It has now been changed so that the area only persists until the boss uses its follow-up attack.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Other wave attacks existed to counter long-range playstyles, but their hitbox ranges were unfair in some cases, causing players to be hit even after dodging the main attack. We have adjusted the collision range so that this no longer happens.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Previously, if the Stage 2 Boss was stunned, it would teleport away. This was intended, but it ended up making players lose valuable damage windows instead of gaining rewards for stunning the boss. We’ve removed this mechanic entirely. This was a major oversight on our part, and we sincerely apologize for the frustration it caused.
[p align="start"]
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Next, regarding bugs:
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We are aware that the game has been crashing intermittently, and we are truly sorry for the inconvenience.
[p align="start"]After reviewing various reports, we discovered that the common cause was related to memory handling. We have addressed the issue, and testing shows that it now works correctly.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]However, we acknowledge that this may not be a complete fix. If the same problem persists after this update, please report it to us so we can fix it immediately. Again, we are deeply sorry for the trouble this has caused.

Reduced the HP and stun resistance of Stage 2 Elite “Three Idiots.”

Greatly increased the respawn time of the “Three Idiots’” hands.

[Main Changes]

1. New System: Added [Armor Break].

[Armor Break] is a new system that can immobilize enemies with super armor. 
The gauge for [Armor Break] fills up with each hit from normal attacks or skills, 
and is displayed as a white gauge around the enemy HP bar UI. 
The gauge decreases over time if not continuously attacked, 
so you need to hit the enemy rapidly and consistently to fully charge it.

Once the gauge is filled to 100%, [Armor Break] occurs, resulting in powerful effects. 
For common monsters, it results in instant death regardless of their health status! 
For champion monsters, elite monsters, and boss monsters with super armor, 
it temporarily disables their super armor and renders them immobile.

Chargeable skills have the following advantages for [Armor Break]: 
Fully charged skills fill the [Armor Break] gauge significantly more than regular skills. 
Hitting an enemy with a fully charged skill at the moment it prepares to attack will 
immediately fill the [Armor Break] gauge to 100%!

Since each skill fills the gauge differently, and each monster requires a different amount to be filled,
you'll need to build your skill deck accordingly if you want to focus on this system.

2. [Unlock] UI Added.

To provide a continuous and diverse playing experience,
